solution_summary: Learn how biotechnology company A-Alpha Bio scaled protein-binding predictions by 10 times while increasing model speed by 12 times using BioNeMo on AWS. Biotechnology startup A-Alpha Bio specializes in harnessing synthetic biology and machine learning (ML) to measure, predict, and engineer protein-protein interactions (PPIs). The company used BioNeMo Framework—a generative artificial intelligence (AI) solution for drug discovery from NVIDIA , an AWS Partner —on Amazon Web Services (AWS) compute infrastructure. Using BioNeMo on AWS, A-Alpha Bio achieved a 12-times increase in throughput of PPI binding predictions, processing over 100 million inference calls—10 times what it had initially projected—in 2 months. A-Alpha Bio conducted training on AWS, supported by a straightforward and efficient setup process. Source data enters the A-Alpha Bio workflow through its application services, processed with Amazon EC2 Capacity Blocks for ML, Amazon EC2 P5 Instances.
